dogs.description: One row per rescue dog. Tracks the full lifecycle: pulled from the shelter -> placed with a foster -> spay/neuter -> photos+bio -> posted for adoption -> adoption appointment -> adopted, including returns ('struggling' fosters, failed adoptions), temporary coverage/bridge fostering, and open health concerns.

dog_name.description: The dog's name exactly as it appears in email (e.g. 'Nettle', 'Rime'). Unique across the rescue.

sex.description: Sex as stated at intake ('adult F hound mix').

age_group.description: Age bracket as stated at intake.

breed.description: Breed mix as stated, e.g. 'hound mix', 'poodle mix'.

intake_date.description: Date the dog was pulled from the shelter (stated in the pull announcement subject/body, e.g. '10/8' -> 2026-10-08). NOT the email sent date unless they coincide.

source_shelter.description: Shelter the dog was pulled from, e.g. 'San Benito County Animal Services'.

status.description: Placement lifecycle. needs_foster = at the den / unplaced (incl. after a decline or completed return). foster_offered = staff offered the dog to a candidate, no acceptance yet. in_foster = a foster accepted / has the dog. returning_to_rescue = current foster or adopter has said they are giving the dog back but handoff not confirmed done. pending_adoption = adoption appointment scheduled. adopted = adoption went through (adopter writes post-adoption updates).

foster_name.description: Current foster's name. Set when a foster ACCEPTS a match (not on the mere offer).

foster_pickup_date.description: Date the foster picks the dog up from the den, when a concrete date is stated or agreed.

return_reason.description: Short reason a placement failed, e.g. 'landlord refused pets', 'too high energy for home'.

coverage_foster.description: Temporary/bridge foster covering while the regular foster is away or between placements.

coverage_start_date.description: Start of temporary coverage, as stated.

coverage_end_date.description: End of temporary coverage, as stated.

spay_neuter_date.description: Scheduled (or completed) spay/neuter surgery date, as stated in vet-day or planning emails. Always the stated surgery date, never the email date.

spay_neuter_clinic.description: Clinic performing the surgery, e.g. 'Crestview Veterinary Clinic, Livermore'.

transport_option.description: Vet-day logistics the foster chose: den_default = drop/pick up at the den at 6:30AM (base option), overnight = crate left at den the night before, direct = foster drives to the clinic themselves.

photos_received.description: True once the foster has sent adoption-listing photos.

bio_received.description: True once the foster has returned the bio questionnaire.

posted.description: True once staff say the dog's adoption listing is live. Rule of the org: posted only after photos + bio + fixed.

health_note.description: Latest open health observation/concern for the dog (e.g. 'cloudy left eye', 'scratching left ear, dark residue'). Includes add-on concerns flagged for a vet-day visit. Overwrite with the newest concern.

adoption_appt_date.description: Scheduled adoption appointment, as stated (e.g. 'Wednesday 10/7 at 11am' -> '2026-10-07 11:00'). Never the email sent date.

adopter_name.description: Name of the (potential) adopter mentioned for the appointment.

foster_applications.description: One row per foster applicant. Created by the automated application form email; moves through intro-call scheduling to approval/decline.

applicant_name.description: Full name, e.g. 'Hugo Ueda' (from the form or subject 'Thank you for your foster application, Hugo Ueda').

email.description: Applicant's email address from the form.

hours_alone.description: Hours the dog would be alone, as given, e.g. '6-8', '9+'.

can_transport.description: Able to transport to/from Redwood City.

ready_within_week.description: Ready to bring home a foster dog within 5-7 days.

status.description: Application lifecycle. received = form arrived / guide sent. intro_call_scheduled = a concrete call time agreed. approved = cleared to foster. declined = staff say it's not a fit this round.

intro_call_date.description: Agreed intro-call date/time, resolved to a concrete date (e.g. 'Thursday at 5:30pm' agreed on 2026-10-04 -> '2026-10-08 17:30'). Only set once both sides agree.

events.description: One row per adoption event (roughly biweekly Saturdays at Bark & Barrel Pet Supply, Redwood City).

event_date.description: The stated event date (e.g. 'Saturday, October 3' -> 2026-10-03). Never the email sent date.

location.description: Venue, e.g. 'Bark & Barrel Pet Supply, Redwood City'.

event_rsvps.description: One row per dog per adoption event: whether the foster confirmed attendance, and any day-of requests (nail trim, check something).

event_date.description: Date of the event this RSVP is for.

foster_name.description: Foster bringing the dog, from the reply's sender/signature.

rsvp.description: confirmed = foster says they'll be there; declined = they can't make it / dog adopted before the event.

request.description: Day-of request, e.g. 'nail trim', 'check scab on flank'.
